order: Short contact-window profiles and tolerance controls before new complete-length campaigns
initial_state: Original initial state; no pose restart or reconstructed checkpoint
changes: One numerical option at a time; same geometry/material/contact/friction/pose history. Dense baseline computes every step but exports the same3 keyframes, isolating compute cost.
timing_scope: Intrusive synchronized stage profile with CPU wall and CUDA stream spans; no assumption that spans equal kernel sums or uninstrumented throughput. Cold setup excluded. Checkpoint overhead absent and explicitly zero accepted-window checkpoints.
limits: These bands guide numerical/cost selection relative to a stricter measured candidate, not physical-reference qualification. PCG caps are recorded and interpreted with actual final residuals/observables; increasing the cap alone is not qualification. A later minimally instrumented matched timing pass is required before a primary throughput claim. Capped-coupling short profiles and reset/phase-aware full keyframe scheduling remain separate required follow-ups.

observer_equivalence_control.scope: Strict numerical observation-mode control; report failures rather than assuming deterministic equivalence. These are not physical-reference tolerances.
